phase: Rosetta Research Workbench Phase I Slice 3
purpose: Expose D0018 and D0020 situated event records and provenance without semantic reinterpretation or browser-local scientific authority.

service_contract.events.list: Read-only pagination/filtering over canonical event fields. Allowed filters: dataset, population/group, split.
service_contract.events.get: Return one source-preserved event record by Event_ID.
service_contract.provenance.get: Resolve event-specific and dataset/source provenance IDs.
service_contract.snapshot: Landing overview must omit bulk event rows and event-level provenance.

presentation_rules: Missing or not-recorded fields remain visibly missing.
D0020 Goal_* values remain anonymized source codes and never become glosses.
D0020 gesture form remains NOT_RELEASED_IN_ANON_CSV where source form is unavailable.
Split and split-eligibility state remain visible, including pre-freeze exposure and locked cross-community evaluation.
Event source locators preserve file/blob/row or communication/source-row span identifiers.
Every displayed event carries at least one resolvable event-specific provenance ID and its relevant source-level provenance ID.
No event field named meaning, translation, semantic_gloss, or english_gloss is permitted in canonical bundles.
fixture_boundary: The packaged fallback contains four real source-preserved sample rows only, clearly marked STATIC_SAMPLE_ONLY; it is not a duplicated event database.
live_boundary: Full canonical event coverage is emitted only by the authenticated canonical producer reading the pinned event spreadsheets.
